expected.subject: dev.product_feedback/derived-state-contracts-2026-09-07
expected.value: Batch 1 design at code baseline 9c0051a5 and design commit 0d2bf0db proposes instance-owned accepted/candidate/operational derived-state contracts. Changesets remain the governed transition; index row/group plans are rebuildable from verified parent plus changeset. Immutable staging revisions prevent candidate memo leakage; per-index/version replay progress commits atomically with data/root. Track negative/range and evidence/time dependencies, separate historical provenance from current assessment, retain exact governed pin/digest meaning, and make storage placement independent of logical keys. Subject referent_sensitivity=identity currently narrows statement identity only: Claim law still pins the exact Subject shell, which has no arbitrary property metadata. Durable CAS/journals/evidence are sources, not disposable indexes. Three design reviews have no outstanding must-fix findings; implementation, scaling tests and any new pin law remain future work. Full authored source: docs/derived-state-contracts-2026-09-07.md; review: docs/reviews/derived-state-design-review-2026-09-07.md. This records the manager proposal, not maintainer adoption.
